step: flatten, fry, soak in thickened milk

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: flatten
steps.note: The chhena is shaped into palm-sized patties, so they take up the milk.

steps.name: fry
steps.note: The patties are deep-fried until reddish-brown.

steps.name: soak
steps.note: The patties are soaked in rabri, a thickened milk flavoured with cardamom.
